title: Seven Tips for Painting Moonlight
content: Here are seven tips for painting landscapes in moonlight:1. Use cool, grayish colors.2. Reduce chroma.3. Unify Shadows.4. Make them nearly opaque.5. But don't go too dark overall.6. Use warm accent lights for contrast.7. Trust your memory more than photos.------More inColor and Light: A Guide for the Realist Painter, 224 pages, softcover, 9 x 10.5 inches.Purchase on Amazonorsigned, directly from me.
